States are grouped without the character keys cq, ab, ave, calor, sudor, abvaso, sobre, splash, vierte, bebiendo, cqfan, fuente and the sign and stamp keys (config.mjs); a thing whose box reads only those keys (movingThings) does not separate states either: its box in every snapshot is in things[id].bySnapshot. The frame of a state shows the characters where the first snapshot of that state had them.

The frames are the scene's draw() only: juego.js's signs (the big hand, the frame around a thing, stars, the heart, answer bubbles) are not drawn; the views add the scene's hud() as the play screen does.
Each frame starts with the canvas default imageSmoothingEnabled = true (the old page keeps whatever the last frame left; order 05 found it on by default).
